name: gpu-workspace
postCreateCommand:
bash -c 'mkdir -p /root/.ssh && if [ -f /tmp/host-gitconfig ]; then cp /tmp/host-gitconfig /root/.gitconfig; fi && git config --global --add safe.directory /workspace && git config --global --add safe.directory "*" && cat >> /root/.zprofile <<EOF
# SSH agent setup: use forwarded agent if available, otherwise start local agent
if [ -z "$SSH_AUTH_SOCK" ]; then
  RUNNING_AGENT="$(ps -ax | grep "ssh-agent -s" | grep -v grep | wc -l | tr -d "[:space:]")"
  if [ "$RUNNING_AGENT" = "0" ]; then
    ssh-agent -s > $HOME/.ssh/ssh-agent 2>/dev/null
  fi
  [ -f "$HOME/.ssh/ssh-agent" ] && eval "$(cat $HOME/.ssh/ssh-agent)" >/dev/null
  ssh-add $HOME/.ssh/id_ed25519 2>/dev/null
fi
EOF
'
